archive.title: TCC Archive
archive.intro: Periodically cleans up branch records in tcc_transaction that have reached terminal state (CONFIRMED / CANCELLED) and exceeded the retention period, preventing unbounded table growth. Business journals, vouchers, and day-cut snapshots are stored in separate long-term tables; archiving tcc_transaction does not affect auditing.
archive.runModeDescPrefix: A background worker scans all 100 shards every
archive.runModeDescMiddle: , DELETEing expired terminal records in batches of
archive.runModeDescSuffix: . Clicking "Archive Now" triggers an additional scan (both are concurrency-safe).
archive.retentionValue: {{days}} days (terminal branches with updated_at older than this will be deleted)
archive.runNowDesc: Immediately trigger an archive scan (up to {{batch}} rows per shard, shards run serially). The endpoint returns immediately; the actual DELETE runs in a background goroutine — check metrics for progress.
